instruction: A seated orangutan sculpted from soft modeling clay, one long arm draped over a bent knee and the other propping up its chin. Thumbprint dents and tool-drag striations texture the burnt-orange fur coat, while the face pad is a smoothed disc of putty-beige with two tiny bead eyes pressed in. Slightly uneven proportions and a visible seam along the shoulder sell the handmade stop-motion look.
